_doc: The census of content classes of GATE-SPEC.md Q23.1 (what the product draws or plays). `spec_names` are the names of the plan's list that a class covers (every name of the list must be covered, or the census is FAIL). `modules` are the folders and files of app/src that implement the class (every folder of app/src must be in a class or in `non_content`, or the census is FAIL). `mark_evidence` is the code that draws or prints the mark of a tier for the class: the runner finds each pattern in its file at every run (a static check; it cannot see what is drawn) and a class with no evidence is an unmarked class. `node_checks` name the results of node tools/bt/gates/q23_app.mjs that run the app's own code (overlay with a recording canvas, sound panel). `datum_classes` link the class to the data classes whose members the flag-in-data check (Q23.2) reads. Nothing here names a tier of any datum.

non_content.ui/: interface chrome: panels, docks and cards. They are where marks are shown, not content that is drawn.
non_content.config.mjs: the shell constants (the tier styles are read from here)

classes.label: Units: regiments, batteries and the formations above them, as marks over the picture and as cards

mark_evidence.what: the unit overlay draws the glyph, outline pattern and colour of the unit's tier
the unit card shows the tier, the source keys and the register link
the unit card prints the tier of each ledger claim it lists

classes.label: Figures and their items, the appearance of officers and commanders, horses and their tack

mark_evidence.what: the unit card prints the tiers of the figure manifest and the tier of the horses

classes.label: Guns and the artillery train
classes.note: the unit card lists the guns of a battery (gunsRows) but prints no tier for the gun count, and no overlay mark exists for a gun or the artillery train

classes.label: Works: earthworks and emplacements drawn as they are built

mark_evidence.what: the works overlay draws the tier colour of each object
the Evidence outlines of the structures use the tier colour, dash and glyph
the object card shows the tier

classes.label: The ground (height model and aerial photograph)

mark_evidence.what: the shell has the note that the ground is the modern landscape

classes.note: the ground is disclosed by one note, not per item (GATE-SPEC Q23 state)

classes.label: Vegetation of July 1863: fields, woods, orchards, trees

mark_evidence.what: the layer shows tiers with the tier mark and a switch for the tier overlay

classes.label: Weather and sky
classes.note: no code in the interface prints or draws a tier mark for the weather state

classes.label: Effects: smoke, fire, muzzle flash, blood, mud
classes.note: no code in the interface prints or draws a tier mark for an effect

mark_evidence.what: the sound panel lists every sound family with its provenance kind and tier, and the disclosure
the unit card shows the tier of the loss share

classes.label: Hospital sites and the activity at them
classes.note: no code in the interface prints or draws a tier mark for hospital activity

classes.label: Animation clips
classes.note: no code in the interface prints or draws a tier mark for an animation clip (the clip table carries a tier)

classes.label: The Events list and the event cards (timeline rows)

mark_evidence.what: the Events list shows the tier glyph of every row and a filter by tier
the time line marks timed events in the tier colour

classes.label: The epilogue: Lincoln, the crowd and the platform (November 19)
classes.note: the product has no epilogue module yet (gate Q28)

classes.label: Later memorials and tour stops (ext modules): not 1863 content, marked as later

mark_evidence.what: the memorial layer draws its tier
the tour panel shows the tier
